name: ArticleHeader
summary: The top of an article: breadcrumb, kicker, title, dek and a byline with the author and date.

guidance.useFor: The start of a journal post or case study, inside its <article>.
insteadUse: The top of a home or landing page: Hero
A post in a list of posts: Post item
content: The kicker carries the category and the reading time: "Craft · 5 min read"
Write the date as people say it; the datetime attribute carries the machine form

rungReason: <header> inside <article> groups its introduction without being a landmark; <time datetime> makes the date machine-readable.

a11y.role: None: a header inside an article isn't a landmark
a11y.name: n/a

props.title: the h1
props.author: a decorative Avatar and the name

rules: Put it inside the <article> it introduces
The author's avatar is decorative: the name is written beside it
